announcements.body:
Cardiology League is an online interactive learning platform designed and created by Dr. Mohamed Alaa, Assistant Lecturer of Cardiology, Alexandria University.

The Basic Edition is created for medical students and interns starting their journey in cardiology.

My aim is to make the basics easier to understand, easier to remember, and more enjoyable to learn.

My message is simple: you do not need to know everything from the beginning. Build your knowledge step by step, understand the concepts, think clinically, and keep challenging yourself.

Through interactive quizzes, clinical scenarios, competitions, and simple challenges, Cardiology League helps you move from simply reading cardiology to actually understanding it.

Build your confidence. Challenge yourself. Enjoy the journey.
